title: Best Voice AI Platforms for Shopify Stores With Phone Support
summary: Compare voice AI platforms for Shopify phone support, including order lookups, returns calls, Gorgias handoffs, live transfers, and integration requirements.
body_markdown:
## TL;DR


This comparison covers spoken customer-support calls, not chat-first ecommerce tools. Shopify supplies store data, and Gorgias manages support work. Neither serves as the voice platform here. None of the cited vendor materials documents a complete Shopify refund workflow.


- **SigmaMind AI:** Best for established phone-support operations that need to work with existing telephony and CRM systems. Its[Shopify connection requires custom-app setup](https://docs.sigmamind.ai/app-integration/shopify.md) , while[warm transfers can pass a call summary](https://docs.sigmamind.ai/transfer-call.md) .
- **Retell AI:** Best for developer-first buyers prepared to build and verify Shopify order lookups and phone handoffs. The cited sources do not document how Retell AI connects to Shopify or Gorgias.
- **Bland AI:** A candidate for a custom inbound-call evaluation if Bland AI can demonstrate the required phone workflows and Shopify access. The cited sources do not verify Bland AI's Shopify connection or support-ticket handoff.


## What this comparison covers and who it's for


Shopify stores with substantial inbound call volume need a platform that answers spoken calls and fits their existing phone operation. A chat agent that handles storefront messages does not, by itself, answer calls or transfer callers to a live representative. This comparison evaluates SigmaMind AI, Retell AI, and Bland AI for phone support.


Gorgias AI Agent, Ada, Sierra, Decagon, and Intercom Fin are not ranked here because this comparison does not assess their spoken-call workflows. If you use one of them for customer service, evaluate its phone capabilities separately.


For each voice platform, we examine whether you can verify a caller before sharing order details, retrieve order or return information with read-only access, and cover calls after hours or during seasonal peaks. We also look at safe escalation and whether a live agent receives the caller’s context during transfer. A claimed Shopify or Gorgias connection alone does not prove that a platform can perform those steps.


## How we evaluated each platform


We reviewed published materials for each platform's order and return access, caller-verification steps, and transfers that pass context to a live agent. We did not test live deployments, so the findings below distinguish documented capabilities from workflows that still need a demonstration.


A Shopify integration claim needs specific permissions behind it. Shopify API access depends on the data and actions a workflow uses. For an app that reads orders through the Shopify Admin API, order lookup generally requires read_orders. Access to[orders older than 60 days](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/latest/objects/Order) also requires read_all_orders and Shopify approval. Check the[applicable Shopify access scopes](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/usage/access-scopes#orders-permissions) for return lookups and refund actions rather than treating read access as permission to issue a refund. We did not treat read access as evidence that a platform can issue refunds. Likewise, a Gorgias connection did not count as ticket or call-summary handoff unless published materials documented that workflow.


### SigmaMind AI


SigmaMind AI fits Shopify brands that already handle substantial phone volume through a dialer or contact-center platform. If you use VICIdial, Five9, NICE, or Genesys, ask SigmaMind AI to demonstrate the connection, inbound routing, and transfer back to an agent in your deployment. Also confirm the implementation work and measure call latency in that configuration. Its Shopify workflow still requires configuration and testing.


We evaluated SigmaMind AI’s published setup guides, not a live Shopify phone deployment. The[Shopify guide](https://docs.sigmamind.ai/app-integration/shopify.md) describes creating a custom app, granting Admin API permissions, and entering its access token through Integration Auth. Grant only the Shopify scopes needed for the lookup you implement, and confirm those scopes against the API operations it calls. You must still configure the lookup, verify the caller before disclosing order details, and test failures. The guide does not demonstrate safely automated refunds.


The[Gorgias guide](https://docs.sigmamind.ai/app-integration/gorgias.md) documents synchronization of macros, tags, rules, and FAQs. It does not document automatic ticket creation or call-summary writing. For escalation, SigmaMind AI’s[Transfer Call tool](https://docs.sigmamind.ai/transfer-call.md) supports cold transfers without context and warm transfers that can give the receiving agent a private whisper summary. Optional SIP headers can carry structured context. Configure transfer destinations and triggers, then test whether your phone system makes that context available to the receiving agent. Writing a Gorgias ticket requires separate implementation and verification.


- **Best for** Established phone-support operations that can configure Shopify data access and test agent handoffs.
- **Pros:** Documented warm-transfer options and Shopify custom-app setup.
- **Cons:** The cited guides do not demonstrate a complete Shopify phone workflow, automated refunds, or automatic Gorgias ticket handoff.
- **Pricing:** Confirm SigmaMind AI’s current per-minute rate, additional speech and model charges, telephony costs, and any concurrency charges before budgeting.


### Retell AI


Retell AI is worth considering if you have developers who can build and maintain the connection between phone calls and Shopify order data. An order-status call needs more than a voice agent. Your implementation must verify the caller, retrieve the permitted order record, and decide what the agent can safely say or pass to a person.


The cited materials do not verify a native Retell AI connector for Shopify or Gorgias, or show a transfer that preserves order context. The proposed Twilio, HubSpot, and Salesforce integrations also need published documentation before this comparison can assess them. Ask Retell AI to demonstrate those steps in your phone setup. Do not assume that[Gorgias’s Shopify actions](https://updates.gorgias.com/publications/shopify-actions-for-ai-agent) extend to a Retell AI call.


Ask Retell AI for current pricing and documentation of any latency or compliance claims relevant to your deployment.


**Best for:** Merchants with developers prepared to build a custom phone workflow.
**Potential fit:** Evaluate whether Retell AI supports the identity checks and order-lookup rules your custom implementation requires.
**Cons:** The cited materials do not verify Shopify access, Gorgias handoff, or context-preserving transfers. Request evidence for any performance or compliance claims before relying on them.
**Pricing:** Confirm current rates and what they include directly before budgeting.


### Bland AI


Bland AI is a conditional option for Shopify phone support because the available sources do not document its ecommerce workflow. They do not establish a Bland AI connector for Shopify or Gorgias, an order-lookup action, or a ticket or call-summary handoff. The cited materials do not show whether Bland AI can use Shopify order data or pass call context into Gorgias.


The cited sources do not establish Bland AI's inbound support workflow or the compliance requirements relevant to your calls. If you need a voice layer for regulated calls, ask Bland AI to demonstrate those requirements alongside caller verification, live transfer, and the integration work needed to access Shopify order data.


**Best for** Buyers prepared to build ecommerce connections after validating the voice and compliance requirements.


**Potential fit:** Evaluate Bland AI for a custom-built phone workflow after a product demonstration.


**Cons** Shopify access, Gorgias handoff, and inbound support remain unverified in the available sources.


**Pricing** No verified pricing information was provided.

## What a real Shopify phone workflow requires


A Shopify phone agent should verify the caller before reading out order details. An order number or incoming phone number alone does not establish identity. You need to define which details the agent can compare with customer and order records, how it handles a failed match, and what information it may disclose. SigmaMind AI’s[Shopify setup guide](https://docs.sigmamind.ai/app-integration/shopify.md) describes a custom app with configured Admin API scopes, but it does not establish a ready-made caller-verification flow.


Order access also depends on the app’s permissions. By default, a Shopify app can access only the[most recent 60 days of orders](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/latest/objects/Order) through the Admin API. To read older orders, the app needs read_all_orders alongside an order scope such as read_orders, plus Shopify approval. A vendor’s “Shopify integration” claim does not tell you whether its phone agent can retrieve the records your callers ask about.


Keep lookup permissions separate from actions that change an order. Order lookup and actions that change a return or issue a refund require different permissions. Confirm the[Shopify scopes and API operations](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/usage/access-scopes#orders-permissions) used for each proposed workflow before granting access. Keep refund approval with a person unless the vendor demonstrates the complete authorization and audit process.


For calls that exceed a verified read-only lookup, route the caller to a person with the call context intact. SigmaMind AI documents a[warm transfer](https://docs.sigmamind.ai/transfer-call.md) that can give the receiving agent a private summary before connecting the caller. A cold transfer sends no such context. Test whether your receiving phone system delivers the summary and whether any Gorgias ticket receives it, rather than assuming either handoff works automatically.


## Why SigmaMind AI fits established phone-support operations


SigmaMind AI merits an evaluation if your Shopify store already handles substantial inbound calls through Five9, NICE, Genesys, or VICIdial. The cited Shopify setup and transfer guides do not, on their own, establish a working connection to your particular phone deployment. Ask SigmaMind AI to show how an agent would connect to your existing phone system, follow your order-inquiry steps, and transfer a caller when the lookup cannot be completed.


For seasonal spikes, ask SigmaMind AI how concurrent calls affect capacity and pricing. Confirm the current platform rate and any speech, model, and telephony charges, then test order access and human transfers before launch. If the documented setup matches your requirements,[contact SigmaMind AI](https://dashboard.sigmamind.ai/p/signup) to discuss a pilot using your existing call routes and expected volume.


## Call-quality monitoring and conversation accuracy


During a pilot, review recordings and transcripts of order-status, returns, after-hours, and transferred calls. Score whether the agent verified the caller before disclosure, used the right order record, stayed within approved actions, and passed useful context to a person. The cited materials do not establish comparable accuracy scores for SigmaMind AI, Retell AI, or Bland AI, so use the same test calls and scoring rules for each vendor.


## FAQs


-


**Can a voice AI platform issue Shopify refunds during a call?** None of the platforms compared here has demonstrated a safely automated Shopify refund workflow. Reading an order does not authorize a refund. Ask the vendor to identify the[Shopify permissions and API operations](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/usage/access-scopes#orders-permissions) its proposed refund workflow uses and to demonstrate how a person approves the action.


-


**How does voice AI differ from a chat-based Shopify helpdesk AI?** A chat-based tool handles typed messages. A voice platform connects to your phone setup to answer spoken calls. Ask the vendor to demonstrate interruption handling and live transfer rather than assuming every platform supports them. Gorgias may hold useful support context, but using it as a helpdesk does not establish that a phone agent can access its records or pass call context into a ticket.


-


**What should I ask a vendor to demonstrate before buying?** Ask for a live call that verifies a caller, retrieves an order using specified Shopify API permissions, and transfers an unresolved case to a person. Check whether the receiving agent gets a whisper summary or other call context. Ask who builds the connections, what work remains for your staff, and how long implementation should take.


-


**How does after-hours or peak-season phone coverage work?** Your phone setup must route eligible calls to the voice agent when staff are unavailable or queues fill. The agent can handle approved lookups, but calls needing a person still require a defined route, such as a staffed transfer or callback request. Chat coverage does not answer calls unless a separate voice workflow connects to the phone system.


## Conclusion


For Shopify stores with substantial inbound call volume, the deciding factors are verified order-data access and safe transfers to human agents. Natural-sounding speech cannot establish caller identity or grant access to Shopify orders. Ask each vendor to demonstrate an order lookup and show what information reaches the live agent when a call needs escalation. Choose a platform that fits your existing phone and support systems, and account for the integration work you can maintain.
